name: allergy-meal-planner
description: Expose declared matches and unanswered label questions.

interface.longDescription: Expose declared matches and unanswered label questions. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare declared allergens and uncertainty; Compare a proposed substitution; Prepare questions for a restaurant or supplier. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare declared allergens and uncertainty.
Help me compare a proposed substitution.

prompts: Help me compare declared allergens and uncertainty.
Help me compare a proposed substitution.
Help me prepare questions for a restaurant or supplier.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Allergen Notes: Meal Checks workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Compare declared allergens and uncertainty. Reproducible inputs: {"avoid":["milk","peanut"],"products":[{"name":"Sauce","declared":["milk"],"label_checked":true,"cross_contact_status":"unknown"},{"name":"Rice","declared":[],"label_checked":false,"cross_contact_status":"unknown"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare declared allergens and uncertainty with these supplied values: {"avoid":["milk","peanut"],"products":[{"name":"Sauce","declared":["milk"],"label_checked":true,"cross_contact_status":"unknown"},{"name":"Rice","declared":[],"label_checked":false,"cross_contact_status":"unknown"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses allergy_meal_planner_allergen_matrix with the supplied inputs. Returns {"products":[{"name":"Sauce","declared":["milk"],"label_checked":true,"cross_contact_status":"unknown","matches":["milk"],"unresolved":["Cross-contact information unknown"],"safety_status":"Not certified"},{"name":"Rice","declared":[],"label_checked":false,"cross_contact_status":"unknown","matches":[],"unresolved":["Label not checked","Cross-contact information unknown"],"safety_status":"Not certified"}],"note":"Exact supplied names only. No match is not evidence of safety; verify full labels, aliases and supplier procedures."}. Shows the actual matrix result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare a proposed substitution. Reproducible inputs: {"original":"Milk","replacement":"Oat drink","function_needed":"moisture","avoid":["milk"],"replacement_declared":["oat"],"label_checked":false}
positive.prompt: Help me compare a proposed substitution with these supplied values: {"original":"Milk","replacement":"Oat drink","function_needed":"moisture","avoid":["milk"],"replacement_declared":["oat"],"label_checked":false}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses allergy_meal_planner_substitution_review with the supplied inputs. Returns {"original":"Milk","replacement":"Oat drink","function_needed":"moisture","avoid":["milk"],"replacement_declared":["oat"],"label_checked":false,"declared_matches":[],"questions":["Does the replacement perform the needed recipe function?","Have its complete label and cross-contact procedures been checked?"],"note":"Documents a proposed substitution; does not endorse it as allergen-safe."}. Shows the actual recipe result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Prepare questions for a restaurant or supplier. Reproducible inputs: {"dish":"Vegetable curry","avoid":["milk","peanut"],"unknowns":["Are the utensils shared?"]}
positive.prompt: Help me prepare questions for a restaurant or supplier with these supplied values: {"dish":"Vegetable curry","avoid":["milk","peanut"],"unknowns":["Are the utensils shared?"]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses allergy_meal_planner_supplier_questions with the supplied inputs. Returns {"dish":"Vegetable curry","questions":["Does Vegetable curry contain milk in any ingredient, sauce or garnish?","How is cross-contact with milk handled?","Does Vegetable curry contain peanut in any ingredient, sauce or garnish?","How is cross-contact with peanut handled?","Are the utensils shared?"],"note":"Questions are prepared only; no supplier was contacted or safety verified."}. Shows the actual checklist result. Does not fabricate external data.
